title: SZA Avoids Drake Romance Questions
htmlContent:
SZA's Hot Ones Moment Steals the Spotlight

SZA found herself in the spotlight on Hot Ones Versus while promoting One of Them Days with Keke Palmer and Issa Rae. In the interview, the singer decided to eat a spicy chicken wing instead of talking about her past romantic connection with Canadian rapper Drake.

A Glimpse Into the Past: SZA and Drake's Youthful Connection

In a previous interview, SZA briefly discussed her relationship with Drake, saying they had a brief relationship in 2009. She downplayed the romance, describing it as light and innocent. “It wasn’t hot and heavy or anything. It was like youth vibes. It was so childish,” she shared at the time. Her comments suggested a casual and playful connection, far from the heated speculation surrounding celebrity relationships.

Keeping it Playful: SZA's Press Tour Humor

SZA showed her sense of humor and resilience when faced with questions about her personal life during her recent media tour. She playfully deflected the spotlight, embracing the interview's fun nature. She even joked about Issa Rae keeping her own secrets from the public during a fun moment.

SZA’s Rising Star: From Music to Film

Fans and critics alike have been impressed by SZA's transition into acting while she continues to dominate the music charts. One of Them Days is an exciting new chapter in her career, and she is collaborating with Keke Palmer and Issa Rae on a film that promises to be dynamic and compelling.

Conclusion: SZA Keeps Fans Guessing

SZA's ability to navigate fame gracefully and with humor is highlighted by her choice to 'plead the fifth' about her connection with Drake. Even if fans remain curious, SZA is focused on her present and future as an artist and an actress. Her charm, talent, and playful personality have made her a beloved figure in the entertainment industry.
